tasks.objective: Resolve the current PO discrepancy: intended event names campaign_landing and demo_started, while actual published first-party src/lib/marketing-analytics.js emits landing_view and demo_started. This is an event-contract naming correction, not installation of a global tracker or a change in what pages are tracked. Keep the original agreed meaning: one anonymous public landing appearance and one successful Demo initialization, no authenticated account navigation. Align landing_view to campaign_landing end-to-end, preserving old per-tab dedupe markers so an already counted tab does not create a duplicate after update. demo_started stays exactly after successful initialization. Record the historic name boundary and how existing landing_view data remains historical; do not send both names, rename/delete provider history, change collector or generate new fake events.
acceptance: Actual module/published app call site uses campaign_landing for the already agreed public landing trigger, and demo_started only after Demo is successfully initialized. Only these two public-event names can go to the collector. Do not broaden to internal URLs, users, students, grades, or automatically tracked pages. Keep deployed cloud.umami.is/api/send endpoint verified earlier; no dashboard/API authentication or additional provider actions.

A fresh tab emits campaign_landing at most once; a tab whose old rakeezx-marketing-landing_view key is already true emits zero extra landing event after update. No per-user identifiers, cookies or old history modification. Demonstrate failed Demo/no-account eligibility/denied DNT or GPC/offline/local or Preview still produces zero requests. Keep credentials:omit/no-referrer, timeout, no retry and nonblocking failure behavior.

Use the actual module and the affected app trigger with isolated synthetic request capture. Prior collector HTTP200 remains evidence for unchanged transport; no extra real visit or full Product suite required. Publish only through the controller/sole publisher and bind served source to the event names; report historical old event separately. Do not close N99 Product without actual acceptance.
tasks.releaseAuthority: Current PO asks whether the two originally intended named events were installed and requests fixing weak spots; prior N99 minimal-event integration and standing routine delivery delegation cover this bounded naming alignment. No new data category, tracking scope, paid service, provider history changes or account access is authorized.
